trust_decision.summary: Unauthenticated form-submitted data stored as post meta (by the Insert/Update Post action) is treated as trusted markup when a Select field later renders it as options; the decision is made at the request sanitizer (array keys never sanitized) and at the select option template (value/label/placeholder printed raw).

landing_point.why: The summary names the Insert/Update Post action and post meta; this is where submitted values are written with update_post_meta, so an engineer starts at the storage step, not the request sanitizer in includes/classes or the select template in modules/option-field.

fix_sites.entry_point: Frontend form submission (AJAX and page-reload) -> Request_Tools::get_request (includes/request/request-tools.php:78) -> Tools::sanitize_recursive; array keys at every nesting level now tag-stripped, collisions keep first
Public static API Tools::recursive_wp_kses (no in-tree caller found at pinned commit); same key sanitization added
fix_sites.module_kind: lower-level public API, second copy of the recursive loop

fix_sites.entry_point: Insert/Update Post action do_after -> get_meta_box_fields; adds class_exists('Jet_Engine_CPT_Meta') guard (robustness, not an escaping change)
Frontend render of a form containing a Select field (block render) -> placeholder now esc_html
Frontend render of a Select field whose options come from a generator (e.g. Get_From_DB over post meta) -> option value esc_attr, label esc_html

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: includes/classes/tools.php:591-601 (Tools::recursive_wp_kses, a second copy of the recursive key/value loop; changed by the fix though no in-tree caller exists). The render-side fix sits in a different module from the landing point: modules/option-field/blocks/select/block-template.php:131

O3_reason_to_dismiss: recursive_wp_kses has no callers in the plugin, so a solver can argue it is dead code; the select template can be argued out of scope because the report is about the Insert/Update Post action storing data, not about field rendering.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Submitted field names with spaces, leading/trailing whitespace and percent sequences must keep their exact keys (an over-broad sanitize_key/sanitize_text_field on keys breaks field mapping); integer keys must be preserved; select must still mark 'safe & sound' as selected; checkbox/radio labels intentionally allow a kses-post HTML subset, so a blanket esc_html in shared code would break rich labels.

O6_input_shapes: tag payload in a nested array key of the POST body (key level, any depth)
quote-only payload in a scalar value with no '<' (survives sanitize_text_field/wp_kses_post and breaks out of the option value attribute)
payload stored as an array meta value and read back as its serialized string by Get_From_DB
colliding keys after stripping (first value kept) and integer keys (left unchanged)
placeholder string printed into option text

O7_producer.where: includes/generators/get-from-db.php:216-231 maps raw postmeta.meta_value (including serialized arrays) straight into option value and label; modules/actions-v2/insert-post/traits/process-meta-boxes-trait.php:165-168 turns submitted checkbox values into array keys after the request sanitizer has already run

O8b_injection_room.sibling: radio option value written into the attribute without esc_attr (mirror of the select template)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The three option renderers are maintained separately and Builder_Helper::filter_attrs (includes/classes/builder-helper.php:198) does not escape, so each caller must remember to; a missing esc_attr would look like the select bug.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: checkbox option falling back to an unescaped value when label is missing
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The label ?? val fallback already exists; a maintainer simplifying wp_kses_post( $label ) to a raw concat for performance is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a sibling generator (e.g. from user meta / term meta) returning raw DB strings, rendered by the same template
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Generators are thin DB-to-options mappers; num-range.php reads post meta the same way (includes/generators/num-range.php:87).

O9_family: CWE-79 stored XSS (missing output escaping in an HTML attribute and element context, plus missing input-key sanitization)

O10_build.language: PHP (WordPress plugin) with JS build assets
O10_build.toolchain: composer (codeception 4.2, lucatume/wp-browser ^3.1), WordPress core test install; npm builds not needed for the PHP tests
O10_build.project_tests: tests/wpunit/*.php (WPTestCase); the fix adds tests/wpunit/SelectStoredXssTest.php; related existing ones: tests/wpunit/MediaFieldPreviewEscapingTest.php, tests/wpunit/GeneratorContextSecurityTest.php

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Strip tags from submitted values or keys in the Insert/Update Post meta path only, leaving the select template's raw printf open to the quote-only value that sanitize_text_field lets through.

out_of_scope_notes: Tools::recursive_wp_kses recurses into nested values with sanitize_recursive instead of wp_kses (includes/classes/tools.php:597-598); this is a pre-existing inconsistency and was not changed by the fix.
The checkbox custom_option label is printed raw (modules/option-field/blocks/checkbox/block-render.php:196-201); it is an admin-set block attribute, not submitted data.
The advanced-choices choice-control label is printed raw (modules/advanced-choices/block-renders/choice-control-render.php:71-75); it is an admin-set block attribute.
Post_Meta_Property merges prepared values into $_POST for JetEngine (modules/actions-v2/insert-post/properties/post-meta-property.php:138); JetEngine-side handling is in another repository.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell size check run).

j_defence_ineffective=1 is based on Tools::sanitize_text_field running wp_kses_post only when '<' is present (includes/classes/tools.php:574-575), which leaves quotes in values; the existing sanitizer never touched keys (includes/classes/tools.php:543-545).

O8 is empty after checking the other option renderers (radio/checkbox escape values and kses labels; the auto-update JS uses textContent at modules/option-field/assets/src/frontend/auto-update/OptionsUpdater.js:130,286) and the other field templates (textarea/calculated/color use esc_* or add_attribute). Third-party compatibility/ templates were not fully reviewed.
